name: ssh-relay-guard
description: SSH Relay Guard (SRG) manages reverse SSH tunnels and transparently routes traffic through your local proxy, bypassing network restrictions and DNS pollution on remote servers.

commands.title: SSH Relay Guard: Setup Remote Environment
SSH Relay Guard: Rollback Remote Environment
SSH Relay Guard: Enable Port Forwarding
SSH Relay Guard: Disable Port Forwarding
SSH Relay Guard: Show Tunnel Status
SSH Relay Guard: Run Health Check
SSH Relay Guard: Show Traffic Monitor

ssh-relay-guard.enableLocalForwarding.description: Enable local proxy via SSH reverse tunnel. When true, the extension manages ~/.ssh/config.srg and forwards the remote port to your local machine.

ssh-relay-guard.localProxyPort.description: Local proxy port on your machine (e.g., 7890 for Clash). Only used when enableLocalForwarding is true.

ssh-relay-guard.remoteProxyHost.description: The host address on the remote server where the proxy is reachable. Use 127.0.0.1 when enableLocalForwarding is true.

ssh-relay-guard.remoteProxyPort.description: The port on the remote server used as the proxy gateway.

ssh-relay-guard.showStatusOnStartup.description: Show a status notification when connecting to a remote server.

enumDescriptions: HTTP proxy (recommended for most proxy software like Clash, V2Ray)
SOCKS5 proxy (use if your proxy only supports SOCKS5)
ssh-relay-guard.proxyType.description: The proxy protocol type. Choose HTTP for most proxy software (Clash, V2Ray, etc), or SOCKS5 if your proxy only supports SOCKS5.
